subject: Chatted w/ Ju An | Harvard iLabs Alumni
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

I lead a medical imaging team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) - working closely with teams at GE Healthcare, Philips, Perceptive, etc. It seems like my team spoke to Ju An recently & a few things came up that might be worth exploring around visualizing / labeling 3D series & leveraging multimodal data (x-ray, audio/speech, Docs, etc).

Would love to get your feedback on what we're building here - would you be open to catch up at some point over the coming weeks? Thursday/Friday generally work best for me.
